CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

2. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   D. Say Work has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   B. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)

7. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)

   B. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.
   D. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   C. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   B. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain The Baptism of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Calming the Storm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Feeding the four thousand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the Paralysed Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich Young Ruler 3 3.9 A Friend at Midnight 3 Page 12 of 87 xii 4.0 The Chur and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
